howto: Pick a hero card, then press FIGHT. Your weapons fire on their own.
Move to dodge the horde and pick up the XP gems enemies drop.
Each level up, choose a new weapon, a weapon upgrade or a passive.
A weapon at Lv5 plus its matching passive evolves into an EVO form.
Survive 10 minutes to clear the stage; spend the gold you earn in the Armory.
tips: Keep moving in wide circles: the horde trails behind you, into your weapons.
Dash (Space) gives you a moment of invulnerability: use it to slip out when you are boxed in.
Elites drop chests with free upgrades: hunt them.
The ULT meter fills as you fight: press R when it glows.
Armory upgrades are permanent, so even a short run makes the next one easier.

controls.keyboard: Enter or Space starts from the title. WASD or arrows to move, Space dash, R ultimate, T opens the turret build bar, Q mortar strike, P pause (Esc also pauses in the arcade).
controls.touch: Drag anywhere to move; tap the lightning button to dash and ULT for the ultimate.
controls.gamepad: Left stick to move, A to dash, Start to pause.

difficulty: Casual, Normal and Nightmare on the title change enemy health, speed, spawn rate, XP and gold; PERIL mode adds +30% enemy health for +50% gold. Within a run the horde grows as the clock runs, with elites and bosses.

cheats.effect: The whole fight runs at half speed

features.difficulty: CASUAL / NORMAL / NIGHTMARE on the title, plus PERIL mode, and chapters that get harder
features.power-up-list: The ARMORY lists every permanent upgrade with its effect and level; level-up cards show each weapon and passive with what it does
features.wave-or-level-counter: The HUD shows your level, the run clock with SURVIVE 10:00 under it, and your kill count
features.high-score-table: RANKINGS opens the Hall of Valor: your top ten runs with score, kills, time, hero and difficulty; the results show your best score
features.results: YOU DIED or SURVIVED! card with time, kills, level, score, best and gold, with Try again
features.tutorial: First run: three pills (move, collect gems, dash), each cleared by doing it, with a skip button; Replay tutorial in How to play
features.hints: Hint reads your state: low health, a pending level-up, or how long is left to survive
